goal: Create a weekly digest of local project status from files already on disk.
inputs: local Markdown notes in the project folder
outputs: a local Markdown digest in the project folder
memory: Keep only the latest digest in the project folder.
human_gate: A person reads the local draft. Nothing is sent or published.
risk_boundary: Never send, publish, purchase, access credentials, or change production systems.
success_criteria: The digest lists every active project found in the local notes.
verification_plan: Read the digest back from disk and check that each local project appears.
